wci.headline: WCI decreased 2% amid weak demand. See detailed commentary below.
wci.text_en:
Our detailed assessment for Thursday, 12 Nov 2026
The Drewry World Container Index (WCI), the benchmark widely referenced by procurement teams, decreased 2% to $4,305 per 40ft container this week, driven by declining rates on the Transpacific and Asia–Europe/Med trade routes. The Transpacific trade route followed the downward trend seen on the Asia–Europe/Med trade route over the past three weeks.
On the Transpacific trade route, rates from Shanghai to New York decreased 3% to $9,020 per 40ft container, the lowest since August 2026, while rates from Shanghai to Los Angeles fell 2% to $7,416 per 40ft container, the lowest since September 2026. To support freight rates, carriers are attempting to manage capacity through blank sailings. According to Drewry's
Container Capacity Insight , eight blank sailings have been announced for next week, compared with four this week. Meanwhile, congestion at Shanghai port increased to 49 hours last week, up from 36 hours the previous week, reversing the easing trend observed over the previous 11 consecutive weeks. However, with demand remaining weak, Drewry expects freight rates to decrease further next week.
On the Asia-Europe/Med trade route, rates from Shanghai to Rotterdam decreased 3% to $3,504 per 40ft container, while rates from Shanghai to Genoa remained stable at $4,168 per 40ft container. Carriers are continuing to manage capacity through blank sailings. According to Drewry’s
Container Capacity Insight , eight blank sailings are announced for next week, higher than five this week. At the same time, carriers have announced higher FAKs and PSS on Asia–Europe/Med Trade routes effective second half of November. These capacity adjustments and surcharge increases could provide some support to freight rates; Drewry expects rates to increase slightly in the coming weeks.
The East-West container shipping market remains uncertain, with freight rates declining amid weak demand. In response, carriers are adjusting capacity and announcing surcharges to support rates in the coming weeks. Ahead of the Lunar New Year, pre-holiday shipments may temporarily support demand. Meanwhile, 53 vessels transited the Suez Canal last week, while only one vessel transited the Strait of Hormuz. Geopolitical uncertainty and ongoing labour negotiations at the ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach remain potential risks to global container shipping. Shippers should expect continued rate volatility in the coming weeks.
Need a more granular picture of global container freight rates?
Subscribe to
Container Freight Rate Insight  for a comprehensive fortnightly & monthly picture of spot market freight rates across 6,700 port pairs. Includes analysis of market developments and the key factors shaping costs across the major trade routes.
paragraphs: 12 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla Drewry Dünya Konteyner Endeksi (WCI), Transpasifik ve Asya–Avrupa hatlarındaki düşüşlerin etkisiyle %2 gerileyerek 40'lık konteyner başına 4.305 dolara düştü. Zayıf talep nedeniyle Şanghay–New York hattında fiyatlar %3 azalarak 9.020 dolara, Şanghay–Los Angeles hattında ise %2 düşüşle 7.416 dolara indi. Asya–Avrupa hattında ise Şanghay–Rotterdam navlun fiyatları %3 gerileyerek 3.504 dolar olurken, Şanghay–Cenova hattında 4.168 dolar seviyesinde sabit kaldı.

Navlun fiyatlarını desteklemek amacıyla taşımacılar boş sefer uygulamalarına ve ek ücret artışlarına gidiyor. Şanghay limanındaki beklemelerin artmasına rağmen zayıf talep koşulları sürerken, Drewry önümüzdeki dönemde navlun fiyatlarında dalgalanmaların devam etmesini bekliyor.
wci.outlook: Drewry, küresel konteyner taşımacılığında zayıf talep ve kapasite ayarlamaları nedeniyle navlun fiyatlarında dalgalanmaların sürmesini öngörüyor.

ABD, 285,9 milyar dolarlık yatırımla toplam küresel fonlamanın %85'ini tek başına karşılayarak liderliği göğüsledi. Çin'in özel yapay zeka yatırımları ise 12,4 milyar dolar seviyesinde kalarak ABD'nin gerisinde kaldı. Açıklanan verilerin yalnızca özel yatırımları kapsadığı ve devlet destekli fonlamaları içermediği belirtildi.
